verdict.rationale: Eqvista's pricing page lists a "Spreadsheet Import" feature, and the site offers migrating a cap table from another provider or a spreadsheet. That points to a first-party bulk-load path rather than one-at-a-time entry, but the depth and self-serve nature of the import are undocumented, and migration is framed as team-assisted white-glove onboarding. Missing for 10: documented self-serve bulk import of grants or historical transactions (template, fields, validation), bulk issuance of new grants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time

citations.quote: Let us migrate your cap table from another provider or spreadsheet to Eqvista, and enjoy fast, white-glove onboarding with the support of our dedicated team.
